map.算法：日剂量 = 体重(kg) × 给药强度(mg/kg)；单次剂量 = 日剂量: Algorithm: daily dose = weight (kg) × dosing strength (mg/kg); single dose = daily dose ÷ doses per day. Weight, strength and dose count must be >0. Always follow medical advice for the actual medication.
map.例1（体重 20kg、10mg/kg、每日 2 次）：日剂量 200mg/天，单: Example 1 (weight 20 kg, 10 mg/kg, twice a day): daily dose 200 mg/day, single dose 100 mg. Example 2 (15 kg, 12 mg/kg, three times a day): 180 mg/day, 60 mg per dose.
